hero.description: Daasebre Fashion and Trainee yɛ Ghana kane nnwuma a ɛyɛ fɛ a wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛfata obiara, wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nnwuma, ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ ntoma.

about.title: Ho asɛm a ɛfa Daasebre Fashion
about.subtitle: Hunu yɛn akwantu ne yɛn anigyeɛ wɔ Afrika nnwuma mu
about.heading: Mfeɛ 15 a Wɔayɛ Nnwuma a Ɛyɛ Fɛ wɔ Ghana
content: Wɔ afe 2008 mu na wɔhyɛɛ Daasebre Fashion and Trainee ase, firi nnwuma ketewaa bi a wɔyɛɛ wɔ Kumasi kɔsii sɛ ɛbɛyɛɛ nnwuma a wɔgye tom wɔ Ghana. Yɛn anigyeɛ wɔ nea ɛyɛ fɛ, nneɛma foforo, ne sɛ yɛbɛhwɛ Afrika ntoma so ayɛ yɛn anya anuonyam wɔ Afrika nyinaa.
Yɛde Afrika ntoma a atena hɔ daa ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ nnɛ yi ayɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ soronko a ɛkyerɛ yɛn amammerɛ ne yɛn anigyeɛ bere a yɛreyɛ nneɛma a ɛfata wiase nyinaa.

testimonials.title: Nnipa a Wɔde Yɛn Adwuma Ayɛ Nneɛma
testimonials.subtitle: Nea yɛn adwuma ayɛ ma nnipa

testimonial1.text: "Daasebre Fashion ayɛ awareɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ fɛ maa me. Wɔn adwuma ne sɛ wɔte m'ani so yɛɛ nea mepɛ no maa me ani gye. Mene Afrika ahemmaa a ɛyɛ fɛ wɔ m'awareɛ da no!"
testimonial1.author: Ama Serwaa

testimonial2.text: "Mene ɔman panyin a ɔgyina Ghana ananmu, enti mehia nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ Ghana anuonyam. Daasebre de nneɛma a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛfa yɛn amammerɛ mu ma me ma me ani gye sɛ megyina yɛn amammerɛ ananmu wɔ amanɔne."
testimonial2.author: Kwame Asante

testimonial3.text: "Nnwuma nkyerɛkyerɛ no ayɛ m'asetena mu yɛɛ fɛ. Mefii sɛ minnim sɛ mede adwuma yɛ nneɛma biara kɔsii sɛ mɛyɛɛ me nnwuma a ɛyɛ fɛ wɔ mfeɛ 18 mu - Daasebre nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ nea ɛyɛ nokware."
testimonial3.author: Esi Mensah
